name: MEZO-SIGNAL-DESK-0
note: Machine-readable form of PRE-REG MEZO-SIGNAL-DESK-0 (zero-training feasibility desk for a zeroth-order credit writer; the prose governs). No MeZO birth authorized; SG stays CLOSED.
status: sealed; Artin GO 2026-09-11 22:34 EDT for DESIGN + PREREG + IMPLEMENTATION + the zero-training desk conditional on clean auditors

states.arena: emb + blocks 0..3 frozen (freeze_lower 4); theta = blocks 4..7 + norm + head, d = 9,456,000 in 30 tensors (21 matrices, 9 vectors)
states.digest_assertion: every state digest asserted against its qual.jsonl before it is read

batches.loss: the control's exact CE objective: dfa_credit.hybrid_objective(k=8) over freeze_lower(model, 4)

precision.reference: float64 on the first 8 directions at the primary eps

oracle: exact BP gradient g of L over theta, one backward per cell; diagnostic only (d_BP, ideal estimators, cosines, the BP virtual step); never an estimator input

families.vanilla: iid Rademacher over all d coordinates (PRIMARY)
families.rank1: the ONE secondary structured family: every 2-D tensor gets u v^T (u, v Rademacher; entries +-1; effective dim rows + cols), 1-D tensors Rademacher; d_eff 36,136; a license here is STRUCTURED-ZO, never vanilla MeZO

readouts.fidelity: per family and eps over the 64 directions: Pearson, median relative error |d_FD - d_BP| / |d_BP|, sign agreement; pooled over 16 cells for the precondition
readouts.ideal_estimator: g_hat_m = mean over a disjoint group of m directions of d_BP_i z_i; cosine to g per group; m in [1,2,4,8,16,32,64]; reference sqrt(m / d_eff) (nominal for rank1)
readouts.actual_estimator: same with d_FD at the primary eps (fp32)
readouts.virtual_step: u = w/||w||; D(u) = min over eta in [1e-3,3e-3,1e-2,3e-2,1e-1,3e-1,1,3] of L(theta - eta u) - L(theta), theta restored; D_BP = D(g/||g||); R = D(u)/D_BP (None if D_BP >= 0); first 4 groups of m in [1,2,4], ideal and actual, per family

precondition.text: vanilla, primary eps, pooled over 16 cells x 64: sign agreement >= 0.95 and median relative error <= 0.10; else NOT-RESOLVABLE-FD (nothing licensed, nothing parked)

bars.text: per family: pooled median over 16 cells x 4 groups of the ACTUAL estimator's descent ratio R at m = 4 >= 0.1 FIRES

verdicts.vanilla_fires: MEZO-LICENSED (bank a MeZO qualification design for a separate GO)
verdicts.only_rank1_fires: STRUCTURED-ZO-LICENSED (bank a STRUCTURED-ZO design for a separate GO)
verdicts.neither: PARK (foreign-writer program parks; TP / EP / ROME do not follow automatically)

fences: two seeds (27, 28) of one arena, one device (Mac CPU fp32, deterministic at fixed threads; no cross-run bit-exact claim)
two fixed probe batches (a fixed-batch loss surface, not the stream)
the descent ratio is line-optimal for both sides and favours the zeroth-order step v a fixed-lr birth: NO-FIRE is conservative in the writer's favour
exact gradient is a diagnostic oracle only
nothing scores a gate, revises L71955, or authorizes a birth
cost: about 1,180 loss evaluations per cell x 16 cells at 0.15 to 0.3 s: about 1.5 to 2 h single-process
